itemized.escalation_note: p3 rows 1-2 band at 480 dpi; p3 amount column rows 1-2 at 900 dpi (settles the superscript-cents '250.00' and the whole-dollar-dash '500,-'); p3 name column rows 1-2 at 900 dpi (third letter of 'ATK' still doubtful after escalation); p3 row 3 band at 750 dpi
itemized.notes: Schedule A row 2's Amount cell is written '500,-' (whole dollars, comma, trailing dash = no cents). Rather than lift a clean prefix out of a malformed decimal, the value is taken from the DOCUMENT'S OWN ARITHMETIC: 250.00 + 500.00 + 750.00 = 1,500.00 closes both the printed page subtotal and the stated Summary-Page total exactly, so 500.00 is certified by the form itself; the verbatim glyph string is kept in the row note and the row carries needs_review. Row 1's cents are a superscript '00' over a rule. Donor addresses were suite/street addresses - discarded at read time, only the filer's city string ('SLC') and state retained. The form's own Page/of box numbers these as page 2 of 3 and 3 of 3 (the cover is not counted), while they are PDF pages 3 and 4. Date of Report on both schedule pages is 1-20-2010 although the clerk lists this as the 2009 Final/Dissolution report - the contribution dates are Sept 2009 and the single expenditure is 1/15/2010.
